name: chat
about: Send a message in the open channel. Starts from an open console and leaves it open.

params.walk_tag: a short tag unique to this walk, e.g. the merge's short sha: it names what the walk makes so a later run can find it

steps.say: open the Chat tab in the rail
steps.expect: the Chat tab is selected and the chat view shows a Send button; no failure state (no failure title such as 'This network does not list this view', no Retry button) and it is not still loading

steps.say: type a short message into the message composer
steps.expect: the Send button is enabled (its state does not list disabled)
a new message card appears in the timeline with an author label (a pending 'sending…' label is fine) and the Send button reports disabled again; no error sentence
